Title: Fishing for eagle's sight - KoT related

Messages.Author: tbz_...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
I have a tapped minion with superior auspex. In my hand I have a copy
of Eluding the arms of Morpheus. I don't, however, have a copy of
eagle's sight. I'm relatively confident that one is still remaining in
my library. Someone cross table is about to oust, and I'd like to stop
them. Is it acceptable to play the EtaoM, in the hope of cycling in
the eagle's sight?

i.e. I play EtaoM, I draw eagle's sight to block cross table - this
obviously is fine.
I play EtaoM, I don't draw eagle's sight so (even if I have
sufficient intercept) the block fizzles, but I'm still untapped. This
makes sense too.

How does this fit with Rachel Brandywine with Homunculus and Madness
Network (or, indeed Enkil Cog)? Could she, if she had the blood to
burn, untap with Homunculus to act out-of-turn then untap with Enkil
Cog to act again, then untap again with EtaoM in response to a cross
table action to act a 3rd time? If you want, you can add in helicopter
too, for a 4th action.

Sure its a costly, unlikely confluence of cards, but is it *possible*?
